camel_example: aliyun paillmtrace GET /api/v1/PAILLMTrace/onlineevaltasks --region cn-hangzhou --Status CREATED_RUNNING_FINISHED_USER_CANCELED --SamplingMethod Window_Ratio --PageSize 50 --Keyword foo --PageNumber 1 --SortBy CreateTime_Status_TaskId_TaskName --MaxTime '2025-04-07_13:24:25_2025-04-07' --SortOrder ASC_DESC --MinTime '2025-04-05_13:24:25_2025-04-05' --AppName 'my-foo-llm-app-1.0' --header "Content-Type=application/json"

EvaluationConfig.description_en: This configuration structure defines the JSON paths needed to extract specific values from trace data in JSON format. They are required for evaluation operations
EvaluationConfig.description_zh: 从json格式的链路数据里要一些提取特定路径上的值，作为评估操作的输入。在这个EvaluationConfig结构体里定义这些json路径

Answer.description_en: The answer to the user's question from the LLM application
Answer.description_zh: 基于大语言模型的应用针对用户问题的回答

JsonPathInSpan.description_en: The JSON path where the Answer is stored in the trace log

JsonPathInSpanValue.description_en: If the value retrieved at the JSON path is itself a JSON string, a further JSON path must be defined within this JSON to obtain the actual value
JsonPathInSpanValue.description_zh: 如果json path处取到的值本身仍然是json string，那么需要进一步定义这个json里的json path以获取实际的值

SpanName.description_en: The span name in the trace log

Context.description_en: The context node information referenced when the model answers a question
Context.description_zh: 大模型回答问题时参考的上下文节点信息

JsonPathInSpan.description_en: The JSON path where the Context is stored in the trace log

JsonPathInSpanValue.description_en: If the value retrieved at the JSON path is itself a JSON string, a further JSON path must be defined within this JSON to obtain the actual value
JsonPathInSpanValue.description_zh: 如果json path处取到的值本身仍然是json string，那么需要进一步定义这个json里的json path以获取实际的值

SpanName.description_en: The span name in the trace log

Query.description_en: The question from the user to the LLM application
Query.description_zh: 用户向基于大语言模型的应用提出的问题

JsonPathInSpan.description_en: The JSON path where the Query is stored in the trace log

JsonPathInSpanValue.description_en: If the value retrieved at the JSON path is itself a JSON string, a further JSON path must be defined within this JSON to obtain the actual value
JsonPathInSpanValue.description_zh: 如果json path处取到的值本身仍然是json string，那么需要进一步定义这个json里的json path以获取实际的值

SpanName.description_en: The span name in the trace log

ModelConfig.description_en: The access configuration structure of the model used in the evaluation
ModelConfig.description_zh: 评估任务内部使用的大模型的访问配置结构体

ApiKey.description_en: The authentication key required when the evaluation task calls a model which the user has permission to use, acting under the user's name
ApiKey.description_zh: 评估任务需要以用户名义调用用户有使用权的大模型时，需要填充的认证key

Endpoint.description_en: The model service endpoint required when the evaluation task calls the model
Endpoint.description_zh: 评估任务需要以用户名义调用用户有使用权的大模型时，需要填充的模型服务地址

IsSelfHost.description_en: Whether the model service is provided by the user (True), or by Alibaba Cloud PAI (False)
IsSelfHost.description_zh: 用户的大模型服务是自己提供的(True)、还是阿里云PAI提供的(False)

Temperature.description_en: Controls the randomness of the model output. Maximum value: 0.2
Temperature.description_zh: 控制大模型输出随机性的温度参数。最大可设置到0.2

TopP.description_en: Controls the randomness of the model output
TopP.description_zh: 控制大模型输出随机性的top p参数

UseFunctionCall.description_en: Whether the model is allowed to use external tools
UseFunctionCall.description_zh: 评估任务需要以用户名义调用用户有使用权的大模型时，是否允许大模型调用外部工具

description_en: View online evaluation tasks that meet the criteria
description_zh: 查找符合条件的链路评估任务
kebab_example: aliyun paillmtrace list-online-eval-tasks --min-time 2025-04-05_13:24:25_2025-04-05 --max-time 2025-04-07_13:24:25_2025-04-07 --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --app-name my-foo-llm-app-1.0 --status CREATED_RUNNING_FINISHED_USER_CANCELED --keyword foo --sampling-method Window_Ratio --sort-by CreateTime_Status_TaskId_TaskName --sort-order ASC_DESC --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOnlineEvalTasks

parameters.help_en: The UTC start time of the search time range
parameters.help_zh: 搜索时间范围的UTC开始时间
parameters.name: min_time

parameters.help_en: The UTC end time of the search time range
parameters.help_zh: 搜索时间范围的UTC截止时间
parameters.name: max_time

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Value range: integers greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数。取值范围：大于0的整数。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认为10，最大为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Name of the user application recorded in the trace data. Exact match
parameters.help_zh: 用户应用在链路数据里记录的名称。完全匹配
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: Search keyword. It will match on fields such as task name, application name (appName), task description, and evaluation metric name
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键字。会在任务名称、任务id、任务描述这些字段上模糊匹配
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: Sampling method for job data. Valid values are window or probability. Exact match
parameters.help_zh: 任务数据采样方式。窗口或者概率。精确匹配
parameters.name: sampling_method

parameters.help_en: Field used to sort the return result. Supported fields: TaskId, CreateTime, TaskName, and Status. If not specified, results are sorted by CreateTime by default
parameters.help_zh: 用于排序返回结果的字段，目前支持TaskId, CreateTime，TaskName，和Status。不填则默认用CreateTime
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: Sort order of the return result. Valid values: ASC (ascending) or DESC (descending). If not specified, results are sorted in descending order by default
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的排序方向。取值范围：ASC（升序）、DESC（降序）。不填则默认用DESC
parameters.name: sort_order

Code.description_en: Internal error code. Set only when the response has an error
Code.description_zh: 内部错误码。只在响应出错时被设置

Message.description_en: Response error message. Set only when the response has an error
Message.description_zh: 响应错误信息。只在响应出错时被设置
Message.example: page number should be greater than 0

AliyunUid.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) of the task creator
AliyunUid.description_zh: 任务创建者的阿里云账号（主账号）

AppName.description_en: The name of the user application targeted by this task
AppName.description_zh: 该任务针对的用户应用的名称

EvalResults.description_en: The aggregated assessment result obtained by aggregation computation from all evaluation results of this job.
EvalResults.description_zh: 从该任务所有的评估结果，通过聚合计算得到的聚合评估结果
EvalResults.example: [{"task_id": "00000", "result_type": "HasValidEvalResult", "record_count": 8, "faithfulness": 0.5, "correctness": 0.5, "ndcg": null, "mrr": null, "hit_rate": null, "precision": null}, {"task_id": "00000", "result_type": "FailedToExtractQCA", "record_count": 3, "faithfulness": 0.0, "correctness": 0.0, "ndcg": null, "mrr": null, "hit_rate": null, "precision": null}]

EvaluationConfig.description_en: Extract specific path values from JSON-formatted trace data as input for the evaluation operation. These JSON paths are defined in this EvaluationConfig structure
EvaluationConfig.description_zh: 从json格式的链路数据里要一些提取特定路径上的值，作为评估操作的输入。在这个EvaluationConfig结构体里定义这些json路径

Filters.description_en: The list define the search filter conditions for the evaluation task to search a certain amount of trace data generated by the user application, which serves as input data for the evaluation operation
Filters.description_zh: 评估任务要搜索一定量的用户应用产生的链路数据，作为评估操作的输入数据。这是定义搜索筛选条件的列表

Key.description_en: The key of the filter condition
Key.example:
ServiceId
ServiceName
Input
Output
Status
TraceType
SpanType
TraceName
SpanName

Operator.description_en: The matching operator of the filter condition

Value.description_en: The value of the filter condition

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The UTC creation time of the task

GmtStartTime.description_en: The UTC start time of the task

ModelConfig.description_en: Access configuration structure for the large model used internally by the evaluation task
ModelConfig.description_zh: 评估任务内部使用的大模型的访问配置结构体

SamplingFrequencyMinutes.description_en: The evaluation task needs to search for a certain amount of trace data generated by the user's application as input data for the evaluation operation. This defines the time window for each data search
SamplingFrequencyMinutes.description_zh: 评估任务要搜索一定量的用户应用产生的链路数据，作为评估操作的输入数据。这是定义任务每次搜索输入数据的时间窗口的宽度

SamplingRatio.description_en: The percentage of the data searched within a time window that is used as input data for the evaluation. For example, 100 means all the searched data is used as input, 20 means 20% of the searched data is randomly selected as input
SamplingRatio.description_zh: 评估任务在一个时间窗口里搜索到的数据，真正作为评估输入数据的百分比。比如100表示搜索到的所有数据都作为评估输入。又比如20表示从搜索到的数据里随机取20%作为评估输入

UserId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud sub-account of the task creator
UserId.description_zh: 任务创建者的阿里云子账号

TotalCount.description_en: Total number of tasks that meet the criteria
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合条件的任务的总数
